title: Food and Tobacco Roasting, Baking, and Drying Machine Operators and Tenders
description: Operate or tend food or tobacco roasting, baking, or drying equipment, including hearth ovens, kiln driers, roasters, char kilns, and vacuum drying equipment.

projection.title: Food and tobacco roasting, baking, and drying machine operators and tenders

tasks.text: Observe, feel, taste, or otherwise examine products during and after processing to ensure conformance to standards.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Food quality needs taste, smell, physical inspection

dwas.name: Inspect food products.
Evaluate quality of food ingredients or prepared foods.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Set temperature and time controls, light ovens, burners, driers, or roasters, and start equipment, such as conveyors, cylinders, blowers, driers, or pumps.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.
Operate pumping systems or equipment.

tasks.text: Observe temperature, humidity, pressure gauges, and product samples and adjust controls, such as thermostats and valves, to maintain prescribed operating conditions for specific stages.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Instrument monitoring needs physical sensor presence

dwas.name: Monitor instruments to ensure proper production conditions.

tasks.text: Observe flow of materials and listen for machine malfunctions, such as jamming or spillage, and notify supervisors if corrective actions fail.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Notifying maintenance needs is routine messaging

dwas.name: Watch operating equipment to detect malfunctions.
Notify others of equipment repair or maintenance needs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Record production data, such as weight and amount of product processed, type of product, and time and temperature of processing.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Weigh or measure products, using scale hoppers or scale conveyors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Weigh finished products.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Operate or tend equipment that roasts, bakes, dries, or cures food items such as cocoa and coffee beans, grains, nuts, and bakery products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cooking with heat and perishable materials

dwas.name: Operate cooking, baking, or other food preparation equipment.

tasks.text: Signal coworkers to synchronize flow of materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Embodied signaling in shared physical workspace

dwas.name: Signal others to coordinate work activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Read work orders to determine quantities and types of products to be baked, dried, or roasted.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.

tasks.text: Fill or remove product from trays, carts, hoppers, or equipment, using scoops, peels, or shovels, or by hand.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically extracting parts from production equipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.

tasks.text: Take product samples during or after processing for laboratory analyses.

dwas.name: Collect samples of materials or products for testing.

tasks.text: Test products for moisture content, using moisture meters.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Food product inspection is sensory and hands-on

dwas.name: Inspect food products.

tasks.text: Clear or dislodge blockages in bins, screens, or other equipment, using poles, brushes, or mallets.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically clearing jams in machinery

dwas.name: Clear equipment jams.

tasks.text: Start conveyors to move roasted grain to cooling pans and agitate grain with rakes as blowers force air through perforated bottoms of pans.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Feeding materials into equipment is physical

dwas.name: Feed materials or products into or through equipment.

tasks.text: Open valves, gates, or chutes or use shovels to load or remove products from ovens or other equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on production flow control

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate flow of production materials or products.

tasks.text: Clean equipment with steam, hot water, and hoses.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual sterilization of cooking equipment

dwas.name: Sterilize food cooking or processing equipment.

tasks.text: Smooth out products in bins, pans, trays, or conveyors, using rakes or shovels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Positioning raw materials is physical loading

dwas.name: Position raw materials on processing or production equipment.

tasks.text: Install equipment, such as spray units, cutting blades, or screens, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting tools requires hands-on setup

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Push racks or carts to transfer products to storage, cooling stations, or the next stage of processing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical moving of products between work areas

dwas.name: Move products, materials, or equipment between work areas.
